description: The doctor day calendar (and Slots tab) has a hard-coded 09:00-18:00 range; appointments after 18:00 are not rendered at all, so today's 18:30/19:00/19:30 OPD tiles (and their Start Visit action) do not exist in the UI.
expected: Every booked appointment for the selected day is visible and startable; the grid extends to the clinic's/doctor's actual hours or at least to the latest appointment.
actual: Grid ends at 18:00; Ananya Gupta 19:30, Kavya Patel 19:00, Priya Sharma 18:30 are absent; story steps 2 and 22 impossible.
suggested_fix: Derive startHour/endHour from doctor availability/branch hours, or expand to min/max of the day's appointments; never clamp an appointment out of view.

description: After switching Calendar/Slots tabs and changing the date, the calendar for "Shravya Dermatologist" on 8 Nov showed Dr. Praneeta's appointment (Sanjay Mehta 12:00) and hid Dr. Shravya's own two appointments (Deepika Nair 11:30, Meera Krishnan 12:00). A reload fixed it.
expected: Tiles always match the doctor shown in the Doctor selector.
actual: Selector says Shravya; tiles belong to Praneeta (stale doctor filter / race between doctor and date fetch).
suggested_fix: Key the appointments fetch on (doctorId, date) and discard stale responses; keep doctor state in one place shared by Calendar and Slots tabs.

criterion: Decision load - defaults carry the user
description: Signed in as Dr. Shravya, the Appointments page Doctor selector defaults to "Praneeta Jain".
expected: A DOCTOR lands on her own calendar.
actual: Defaults to another doctor; the doctor must notice and switch every time.
suggested_fix: Default doctorId to the signed-in user when role is DOCTOR.

description: Calendar tile actions (INFO / RESCHED / START) are invisible until mouse hover, on a ~18px-tall tile; "RESCHED" is an abbreviation; touch users have no hover.
expected: Start Visit visible (or the whole tile clickable) without hover; tap target >= 32px.
actual: Actions appear only on hover at the far right of the row.
suggested_fix: Make the tile itself open the appointment/visit, show START persistently for today's scheduled tiles, spell out "Reschedule".

criterion: Text fit & wrap - control labels / badges
description: At 1280x800 the visit form header card is crushed: DRAFT/COMPLETED badge 37x81px with one letter per line, "Linked to Appointment" 87x81, "0 Photos" 42x81, "Visit Workflow Tour" 46x91, Shortcuts button 64x185 stacked letter-by-letter; patient-ID chip text spills outside its pill.
expected: Badges and buttons stay on one line; header wraps as a row of chips below the title if space is short.
actual: Badges/buttons are squeezed by flex siblings and break mid-word (overflow-wrap:anywhere).
suggested_fix: Give badges whitespace-nowrap/shrink-0 and let the badge row flex-wrap; move Tour/Shortcuts into an overflow menu; truncate the ID with title tooltip.

description: Opening the Prescription tab makes <main> overflow horizontally (scrollWidth 1407 vs clientWidth 1024). The builder (1182px wide) is clipped on the right: Pulse field, template buttons, Create Prescription, and the form footer Save Draft / Complete Visit (x=1373-1638) are off-screen at 1280px.
expected: Prescription builder fits the content column; footer actions always visible.
actual: User must discover horizontal scrolling inside main to reach Create Prescription / Complete Visit; sidebar overlays scrolled content.
suggested_fix: Remove fixed min-widths in PrescriptionBuilder (table/min-w), let the medication table scroll inside its own container, and collapse the Patient Context column while on the Prescription tab.

description: CONFIRMED mapped defect #2. With vitals, photos, complaints, diagnosis, exam and a created prescription (60%), Complete Visit is disabled with no tooltip; Ctrl+Shift+S toasts "Fill vitals, complaints, diagnosis, and prescription to reach at least 80%". Only pressing "Save Labs" on the Lab Tests tab (labs are optional clinically) reaches 80%.
expected: A visit with vitals + complaints + diagnosis + Rx can be completed; or the message names exactly what is missing.
actual: Hidden requirement: >=1 photo AND Save Labs; message lists things already done.
suggested_fix: Base the completion gate on required clinical fields, not on 4-of-5 tab checkmarks; list missing items in the disabled-button tooltip and toast.

description: The first "Mark Vitals Complete" (which creates the visit) toasts "Visit saved" but does not mark Vitals complete; progress stays "0% - 0 of 5". A second click is required to get the green dot and 20%.
expected: One click saves and marks the Vitals section complete.
actual: Section completion lost when the visit is first created (state reset when visitId appears).
suggested_fix: Preserve completedSections across the create->visitId transition (or mark after the reload of server state).

description: Visit page sub-heading reads "Patient: Unknown • Doctor: Dr. • 19:30-19:45 • OPD" even when opened from an appointment for a known patient and doctor (same root cause as mapped defect #1: the page only holds the first patient/doctor).
expected: Shows the appointment's patient and doctor names.
actual: "Unknown" and an empty "Dr." beside the correct Patient Context card.
suggested_fix: Resolve names from the appointment/patient fetch instead of the limit=1 lists.

description: CONFIRMED mapped defect #9: Overview "Photos Captured: 0" while header badge says "3 Photos" and Photos is Complete.
suggested_fix: Bind to the live photo count or remove the row.

description: With "Compare with previous visit" ticked for a patient who has no previous labs, every row shows "Δ +0", and after typing values "Δ +18" (Vitamin D) / "Δ +12.1" (Hb) - deltas against an implied previous value of 0.
expected: Show "—" / "No previous value" when there is no baseline.
suggested_fix: Only render a delta when a previous numeric value exists.

description: Lab Tests tab: "Save Labs" button rendered one letter per line (S/a/v/e/L/a/b/s), footer "Save Draft" and "Complete Visit" wrap onto two lines, result inputs clip values ("12.1", unit "g/d"), and the photo-autofill file input is the unstyled native "Choose File No file chosen".
expected: Buttons single-line; inputs wide enough for values and units; styled file picker.
actual: Crushed flex children in the lab footer row and result grid.
suggested_fix: Use whitespace-nowrap/shrink-0 on buttons, stack the footer row, widen value/unit inputs.

description: After "Visit completed" the header still shows "Unsaved changes", the local draft key (clinic:visit-draft:...:visit-<id>) remains in localStorage, and the PatientProgressTracker CTA reads "Continue".
expected: Completed visit shows Saved/Completed state and the draft is cleared (as the story describes).
suggested_fix: Reset dirty state and clear the draft key after complete; make tracker CTAs reflect COMPLETED.

description: Patient Context "Recent Visits" lists the current visit itself with "No diagnosis" even after the diagnosis was saved and the visit completed; the History tab on the same screen shows "Acne vulgaris".
expected: Context card refreshes and excludes the current visit.
suggested_fix: Refetch recent visits after save/complete and exclude the open visit.

description: Vitals inputs have no units (Temperature °F or °C? Weight kg? Height cm?) and their <label>s are not associated with inputs (no for/id), so screen readers announce unlabeled fields.
expected: Units shown in label or adornment; labels programmatically tied to inputs.
suggested_fix: Add unit adornments and htmlFor/id pairs.

description: In the "Tag photo positions" dialog (Single mode) the Upload button sits at y=988 in a 720px-high modal; the position Select and Upload are hidden below a full-height preview until the user scrolls inside the dialog.
expected: Upload/Cancel in a sticky dialog footer.
actual: Must scroll inside the dialog to find Upload.
suggested_fix: Cap preview height (e.g. 50vh) and make the footer sticky.

description: At 390x844 the visit form keeps two columns side-by-side: Patient Context and the form card overflow by up to 414px, the patient ID and COMPLETED badge stack one letter per line, and Save Draft / Complete Visit / Back to Setup wrap.
suggested_fix: Stack columns below md; hide/collapse Patient Context into a drawer.

description: Destructive red buttons ("Delete" in the Photos header, "Reset to default" in the Prescription template bar) are the most saturated elements on screen; Photos also duplicates Upload/Camera in the header with Choose Files/Take Photo in the empty state.
expected: Destructive actions de-emphasized (outline/ghost); one upload entry point.
actual: Red solid buttons compete with the primary action.
suggested_fix: Use outline-destructive styling; drop the duplicate header buttons when the empty state is shown.

description: The PatientProgressTracker under the heading offers "Start Visit" while the visit form is already open, "Book" for an appointment that is already booked, and "Continue/View/Bill" after completion; "From Appointment" and "Linked to Appointment" badge the same fact twice.
expected: Tracker CTAs reflect the current state; appointment linkage shown once.
suggested_fix: Hide the tracker CTA row inside the form, or compute it from visit status; keep a single linkage badge.
